Our business is a local tour company and not affiliated with the National Medal of Honor Museum.

Your visit includes a private Tour Guide to enhance your experience when exploring the National Medal of Honor Museum.

Over 40 million Americans who have served in the US Armed Forces since the Civil War. Fewer than 4,000 have been awarded the Medal of Honor. Stand in the presence of nations heroes and experience their stories of valor firsthand.
